bootstrap_rule.implementation_reference: argine.research2.r2_11.bootstrap.paired_bootstrap_ci (frozen in this Phase-0; not executed against real R2-11 data in this phase -- unit-tested only on synthetic/mock deltas).
bootstrap_rule.input: the 12 paired per-instance deltas (delta_i(4GiB) = PredictedProtectPolicy_i(4GiB) - B_selected_i(4GiB))
bootstrap_rule.procedure: paired bootstrap over workload instances: resample 12 instances WITH replacement as paired units (both policies' values for a resampled instance travel together; never resample policies independently; never use token-level pseudo-replication), compute the equal-weight mean delta of each resample, repeat for the frozen resample count, then take the empirical percentile interval of the resulting distribution of means as the confidence interval.
bootstrap_rule.quantile_method: linear interpolation of the empirical CDF (numpy.percentile default 'linear' method), taken at the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the 100000 resampled means, for a two-sided 95% CI.

forbidden_claims: runtime speedup -- these belong to R2-12, not R2-11
never_changes_historical_r2_11_not_propo: The historical statement 'R2-11 NOT PROPOSED under the original R2-10 frozen rules' (R2-10 PHASE3L-FINAL-CLOSURE-RECORD.json) is not rewritten by this protocol's existence; R2-11 exists only because of NEW prospective R2-BRIDGE-01 evidence (BRIDGE_POSITIVE), as recorded in provenance.json.
no_post_hoc_thresholds: These rules are frozen at Phase-0, before any R2-11 capture or scoring. No threshold may be added, removed, or adjusted after EVAL opening or after results exist. Do not change these rules after opening EVAL.

practical_effect_interpretation.note: A statistically/experimentally robust but tiny retention improvement may justify R2-12 precisely because R2-12 exists to determine whether such a retention effect translates into measurable runtime benefit. A tiny effect must not be called 'large' or 'material' without runtime evidence.

R2_11_BLOCKED_INVALID.applies_when: a scientific-validity or instrumentation failure occurs (e.g. a budget violation, a leakage/causality test failure, a non-deterministic replay, or an incomplete/rejected trace that cannot be resolved by repair). This is NOT automatically R2_11_FAIL; it is a separate state used until repaired or resolved prospectively.
R2_11_BLOCKED_INVALID.note: A scientific-validity/instrumentation failure is not automatically R2_11_FAIL, per instruction #13.

R2_11_FAIL.applies_when: primary 4 GiB mean delta >= 0, OR the selected policy is directionally worse on the primary aggregate.

R2_11_INCONCLUSIVE.applies_when: the primary mean delta is negative but one or more robustness/CI/consistency requirements for PASS fail, AND there is no scientific-validity failure.

requires_all: at least 9 of 12 fresh workloads have delta <= 0 at 4 GiB
no single workload contributes more than 50% of the total positive byte reduction among improving workloads

r2_12_gate.if_R2_11_FAIL: R2-12 is NOT proposed from this evidence.
r2_12_gate.if_R2_11_INCONCLUSIVE: R2-12 is NOT automatically justified. Close R2-11 as inconclusive unless a separately designed prospective replication is later authorized.
r2_12_gate.if_R2_11_PASS: R2-12 MAY BE PROPOSED FOR PROSPECTIVE RUNTIME VALIDATION.
